correctness.rationale: A (k+1)th finite difference of the degree-\(k\) polynomial \(F(q)=\binom{qk}{k}\) gives \(D(k)\mid k+1\). The complete Kummer carry decomposition for \(q-1=up^a+r\) proves at least a carries for every multiplier, \(r>0\) and \(r=0\) handled separately. Published Guo et al. Lemma 9 excludes cofactor primes because \(m<p\). These establish \(D(mp^a-1)=p^a\). All assumptions checked; 78,683 exact multiplier valuations, 2,779 carry comparisons and 80 full gcds replayed.

value.rationale: The complete positive gcd and its full p-adic exponent are natural arithmetic refinements of the solved OEIS A080170 zero/nonzero criterion. The cofactor \(m<p\) is a structural single-base-p-digit domain that makes the carry saturation exact; the result covers infinitely many values and gives maximal prime-power divisibility for every exponent, beyond finite tabulation or a one-prime sign check. Arbitrary cofactors remain open.
